label_use: Value semantics: every entry of struct_log.npy is computed from base-table data and the query structure; no true cardinality feeds any computed value. Reading boundary, stated precisely: the queries path parses the workload file, whose rows are 'SQL || exact_cardinality || pg_estimate'; read_workload (spatial_meta_ce/manifests.py:52-79) parses all three fields and uses exact_cardinality as a consistency gate (two different values for the same canonical SQL raise). source['true'] is used only by the verify/bineval stages; source['pg'] only by the --on-failure pg branch, which did not run (on_failure=fail, failure_count=0). cards.npy is never opened.
note: imdb has no finetune cache, so its evaluation is K=0 only (doc 102 §3.1). No finetune-split target sidecars were generated: step 5 is K=0, so they are not needed. The 4 min 16 s batch wall-clock is dominated by imdb (~4 min 14 s); the other three wrote their sidecars within the first minute.
